mapper.sql: i.*, a.name AS account_name, a.provider, m.owh_code, w.name AS warehouse_name
FROM ecom_owh_inbound i JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = i.account_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.id = i.mapping_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id

sql.if: AND (i.inbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.owh_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.source_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT i.status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_owh_inbound i
GROUP BY i.status
SELECT * FROM ecom_owh_inbound WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'INBOUND' AS "sourceType", ib.id AS "sourceId", ib.doc_no AS "sourceNo", ib.to_warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.name AS "warehouseName", ib.total_qty AS "totalQty", COALESCE(ib.ship_date, CAST(ib.create_time AS DATE)) AS "bizDate", ib.status AS "status", ib.box_count AS "boxCount", ib.tracking_no AS "trackingNo", ib.create_time AS sort_time FROM ecom_inbound ib JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.warehouse_id = ib.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = ib.to_warehouse_id WHERE ib.status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVING', 'SHIPPED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_owh_inbound x WHERE x.source_type = 'INBOUND' AND x.source_id = ib.id AND x.status <> 'CANCELLED') AND ib.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT 'TRANSFER', d.id, d.doc_no, d.to_warehouse_id, w.name, d.total_qty, d.biz_date, d.status, NULL, NULL, d.create_time FROM wms_stock_doc d JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.warehouse_id = d.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.to_warehouse_id WHERE d.kind = 'TRANSFER' AND d.status = 'TRANSIT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_inbound ib WHERE ib.transfer_doc_id = d.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_owh_inbound x WHERE x.source_type = 'TRANSFER' AND x.source_id = d.id AND x.status <> 'CANCELLED') AND d.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) src ORDER BY src.sort_time DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT d.id AS "id", d.doc_no AS "docNo", d.status AS "status", d.kind AS "kind", d.to_warehouse_id AS "toWarehouseId", d.biz_date AS "bizDate" FROM wms_stock_doc d WHERE d.id = #{id}
